title: BNA Blue Retreat, Game Room, Hot Tub
description:
The Ultimate Nashville Airbnb Experience! Custom 4 BR/3BA 3200 square foot house only 4 miles from Downtown Nashville! This house has it ALL including a stage, gym, glam room, hot tub, game room, 2 decks, fire pit, and 9 beds! Games include a pool table, ping pong, golden tee, NBA jam, foosball, & darts! Karaoke and guitars provided! The house is on 1 full acre and feels completely secluded but is only 4 miles from Downtown! Indoor and Outdoor dining for 12!  Pets Welcome and Ample Parking!

The space
The two story house has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms upstairs and 1 bedroom, a bath, and the gym downstairs.  Two decks provide tons of outside space, and there is ample parking. Bedroom layout is a king room, two queen/queen rooms, and a bunk room with two twin/twin adult size bunk beds.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire house, hot tub, and 2 decks.

Other things to note
PLEASE READ ALL HOUSE RULES BEFORE BOOKING!
